message.content: Starting the hunt with head-on, high-energy collisions to stress the integrator.
That head-on pass held together; now I'll push close-packed massive bodies at maximum step size.
Spacing was too tight — I'll retry with valid separation to probe the energy regime.
Still conservative — testing whether a tight six-body collapse can overwhelm the adaptivity.
Cold starts conserve well, so I'll try fast slingshots past heavy masses with grazing encounters.
A slingshot encounter triggered a momentum violation. I'll shrink it to a minimal case and dig into the evidence.
Shrink isolated a two-body slingshot. I'll replay it to confirm it's deterministic.
Confirmed deterministic — now gathering the full violation trace for the report.
Violation list complete. I'll inspect the exact states bracketing the failure.
Got the violating step; now checking a few steps before to capture the onset.
Step 15 is clean, so I'll inspect closer to pinpoint where the fast mover leaves the tolerance.
